lexemes.grid_description: A GuessWord grid: guess a five-letter word in six tries. After each guess, tiles turn green for correct letters in the right place, yellow for letters in the wrong place, and grey for letters not in the word.

lexemes.guide_rules_title: Do you know the rules of [[name]]?
lexemes.guide_tour_more_body: Tap here for settings and more options.
lexemes.guide_tour_grid_body: Each guess fills a row, then the squares change colour to show how close you were.
lexemes.guide_tour_keys_body: Type a word and press Enter. The keys change colour too, so you can see which letters you've tried.
lexemes.guide_tour_settings_body: Print the puzzle, find How to play, and change settings such as the timer and hard mode.
lexemes.settings_hardMode_description: Any letters you've found must be used in your later guesses.
lexemes.modal_onboarding_slide_01: You have six tries to guess a five-letter word. Type your guess on the keyboard, then press Enter to submit.
lexemes.modal_onboarding_slide_02: Green means the letter is in the word and in the right place. Yellow means the letter is in the word but in the wrong place. Grey means the letter isn't in the word.
lexemes.modal_onboarding_slide_03: Only real words are accepted. If your guess isn't in the word list, the row will shake and you can try again.
lexemes.modal_reset_title: Are you sure you want to reset the puzzle?
lexemes.settings_autoEnterGreens_description: Letters you've already got in the right place are filled in for you on the next row.
